我的鱼！不，我的鱼！ (Chinese (Simplified)) 一个关于三条鱼和三个好朋友的有趣故事！ This is a Level 1 book for children who are eager to begin reading. Pratham Books goes digital to weave a whole new chapter in the realm of multilingual children's stories. Knitting together children, authors, illustrators and publishers. Folding in teachers, and translators. To create a rich fabric of openly licensed multilingual stories for the children of India and the world. Our unique online platform, StoryWeaver, is a playground where children, parents, teachers and librarians can get creative. Come, start weaving today, and help us get a book in every child's hand!

pages.originalText: 一个温暖的早晨，拉加打着哈欠醒来，他对自己说：钓鱼去！
pages.text: 一个温暖的早晨，拉加打着哈欠醒来，他对自己说：“钓鱼去！”

image.attributionText: Page 2: Boy waking up and stretching in the morning , by Soumya Menon © Pratham Books, 2014. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText: 在去池塘的路上，他遇到了好朋友兰姆，他邀请兰姆一起去池塘。
pages.text: 在去池塘的路上，他遇到了好朋友兰姆，他邀请兰姆一起去池塘。

image.attributionText: Page 3: Boys holding fishing rods and talking , by Soumya Menon © Pratham Books, 2014. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText: 西塔看到他们去钓鱼。男孩们问她想不想和他们一起去。
pages.text: 西塔看到他们去钓鱼。男孩们问她想不想和他们一起去。

image.attributionText: Page 4: Girl standing behind tree and talking to two boys carrying fishing rods , by Soumya Menon © Pratham Books, 2014. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText: 西塔想了想，她说，“别去，鱼儿们离开了水就会死的“
pages.text: 西塔想了想，她说：“别去，鱼儿离开水会死的。”

image.attributionText: Page 5: Girl with cat talking to two boys carrying fishing rods , by Soumya Menon © Pratham Books, 2014. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText: 他们没有理会她，继续走向池塘。
pages.text: 他们没有理会她，继续走向池塘。

image.attributionText: Page 6: Girl and cat going after two boys walking ahead with fishing rods , by Soumya Menon © Pratham Books, 2014. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText: 拉加和兰姆坐在池塘边，他们看见鱼儿在水里跳跃，一只很瘦，一只胖胖的。
pages.text: 拉加和兰姆坐在池塘边，他们看见鱼儿在水里跳跃，一只很瘦，一只胖胖的。

image.attributionText: Page 7: Girl and cat looking at two boys fishing , by Soumya Menon © Pratham Books, 2014. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText: 又游来第三条鱼。他们从没见过这么大的鱼。西塔说：“这条鱼比我父亲的脚还大！”
pages.text: 又游来第三条鱼。他们从没见过这么大的鱼。西塔说：“这条鱼比我父亲的脚还大！”

image.attributionText: Page 8: Two boys fishing and girl and cat, big fish nearby , by Soumya Menon © Pratham Books, 2014. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText:
拉加和兰姆拿出他们的钓鱼竿，努力地抓住这条鱼。

兰姆说：“它是我的！”

拉加说：“不，它是我的！”
pages.text:
拉加和兰姆拿出他们的钓鱼竿，使劲想钓起这条鱼。
兰姆说：“它是我的！”
拉加说：“不，它是我的！”

image.attributionText: Page 9: Girl and cat looking at two boys fighting , by Soumya Menon © Pratham Books, 2014. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText: 拉加拉着鱼竿，兰姆拉得更用力。
pages.text: 拉加拉着鱼竿，兰姆拉得更用力。

image.attributionText: Page 10: Two boys pulling hard at their fishing rods , by Soumya Menon © Pratham Books, 2014. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText: 嘭！他们摔倒在地上，原来他们的钓鱼竿断了。
pages.text: 嘭！他们摔倒在地上，原来他们的钓鱼竿断了。

image.attributionText: Page 11: Fishing rods breaking and two boys falling down , by Soumya Menon © Pratham Books, 2014. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText:
你知道为什么吗？

猜猜看？

鱼儿们把他们的钓鱼竿系在了一起！

dimensions.literacy: 钓鱼、池塘、大鱼、我的等具体词在完整情节中反复，男孩争抢对白简短易读。
dimensions.story: 两个人抢同一条鱼，结尾鱼儿把鱼竿系在一起，拟人反转幽默；小朋友能边看边猜。
